premise: On a grey morning Butterfly can't fly, her wings are too cold; Bee tries to fan her warm (brrr, colder!) and hums her a sunny tune, Pinecone waits with her, and when the clouds part they both open wide in the sun.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop), turned: blowing only makes it colder, and the warmth that works is the one you wait for together.
lesson: Some things can't be hurried, and waiting is easier with friends.
learning: Butterflies warm their wings in the sun before they can fly.

en-US.title: Butterfly Waits for the Sun
en-US.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7} {bee:float loop 0.3} [softly] It was a grey, cloudy morning. {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:go to meadow} Butterfly sat in the grass and tried to fly. {butterfly:live flap} Flap, flap… nothing. {butterfly:face sad} [sad] "My wings are too cold," she sighed. "I can't fly with cold wings." {bee:enter} Bee came buzzing by. {bee:face happy} {bee:go to butterfly} "I'll warm you up!" {sfx:buzz} Bzzz! {bee:live fan} She fanned her wings as fast as she could. {butterfly:tint #9AD0FF} "Brrr! That's even colder!" [giggles] So Bee {bee:live hum} hummed her sunniest tune. Still cold. Then along rolled {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to butterfly} Pinecone. [gently] "When it's cold, I wait for the sun." So they waited, all three together. {butterfly:live rest hold} Butterfly folded her wings. "Come out, sun," they whispered. "Come out, sun." {canvas:clouds stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 22s} Slowly, the clouds drifted away… and out came the sun, warm and golden. {butterfly:live rest resume} Butterfly opened her wings to the sun. {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} Pinecone opened her scales. {butterfly:face happy} "Warm at last!" {butterfly:go to sky} {bee:go to butterfly} {sfx:flutter} Up she fluttered, {bee:face happy} {bee:hop x2} and Bee bobbed along beside her. [happily] And on grey mornings after that, three friends sat in the grass together, whispering: "Come out, sun."

es-ES.title: Mariposa espera al sol
es-ES.text: {canvas:clouds 0.7} {bee:float loop 0.3} [softly] Era una mañana gris, llena de nubes. {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:go to meadow} Mariposa, en la hierba, intentó volar. {butterfly:live flap} Aleteó y aleteó… y nada. {butterfly:face sad} [sad] —Tengo las alas heladas —suspiró—. Y con las alas frías no puedo volar. {bee:enter} Abeja pasaba zumbando. {bee:face happy} {bee:go to butterfly} —¡Yo te las caliento! {sfx:buzz} ¡Bzzz! {bee:live fan} Y le hizo aire rapidísimo. {butterfly:tint #9AD0FF} —¡Brrr! ¡Ahora tengo más frío! [giggles] Así que Abeja {bee:live hum} le tarareó su canción más soleada. Ni por esas. Entonces llegó rodando {pinecone:enter} {pinecone:go to butterfly} Piña. [gently] —Cuando hace frío, yo espero al sol. Y esperaron las tres juntas. {butterfly:live rest hold} Mariposa plegó las alas. —Sol, solito —susurraban—, caliéntanos un poquito. {canvas:clouds stop} {canvas:sunshine 0.8 22s} Poco a poco, las nubes se fueron… y salió el sol, dorado y calentito. {butterfly:live rest resume} Mariposa abrió las alas al sol. {pinecone:face happy} {pinecone:live open hold} Piña abrió sus escamas. {butterfly:face happy} —¡Por fin, calentita! {butterfly:go to sky} {bee:go to butterfly} {sfx:flutter} Y echó a volar, {bee:face happy} {bee:hop x2} con Abeja dando botes a su lado. [happily] Y desde entonces, las mañanas grises, tres amigas se sientan en la hierba y susurran: «Sol, solito, caliéntanos un poquito».

buzz.prompt: a small bee buzzing close by, wings whirring fast, realistic
